objectives.statement: Identify the three component groups separated by the Model-View-Controller pattern.
Define an ASP.NET Core MVC controller as a class that defines and groups actions.
Define Razor as a markup syntax for embedding .NET-based code in webpages.
Identify the Bootstrap grid as a mobile-first flexbox layout based on containers, rows, columns, and twelve columns.
Explain the normal MVC request flow from routing a request to a controller through model work and selecting a view.
Explain that an MVC action is a controller method that handles a request and commonly returns an IActionResult or an asynchronous equivalent.
Identify an ASP.NET Core MVC view as a .cshtml HTML template containing Razor markup and C#.
Explain how Bootstrap containers, rows, and columns compose a responsive twelve-column flexbox layout.
Distinguish conventional routing from attribute routing in ASP.NET Core MVC.
objectives.citation: Conventional routing; Attribute routing for REST APIs

objectives.statement: Explain how a layout shares common page structure such as headers, navigation, scripts, and footers across views.
Explain that the Razor @ symbol transitions from HTML markup to C# or Razor-specific markup.
Distinguish Bootstrap .container from .container-fluid in responsive layouts.
Explain that route templates describe URL matching and can be used for URL generation.
Identify common ASP.NET Core MVC controller conventions involving the Controllers folder, Controller suffix, and Controller base class.
Explain that the Razor @model directive specifies the type of the model passed to a view and its Model property.
Explain Bootstrap's six default breakpoints as min-width tiers used by its mobile-first responsive design.
Distinguish a partial view as reusable view content from a view component used when server-side code is needed to render content.
Explain how a view selects a layout and how RenderBody places the view content in that layout.
Diagnose why an implicit Razor expression containing a generic method call such as @GenericMethod<int>() is invalid and requires an explicit expression.
Interpret a responsive Bootstrap class such as .col-sm-4 as four of twelve columns at the sm breakpoint and above, with mobile-first behavior below it.
